brand.name: FoodSafe Easy
brand.tagline: Simple, accessible food safety complaint reporting

step1.title: What is wrong with the food?
step1.subtitle: Tap the card that best matches your problem

spoiled.title: Spoiled or Rotten Food
spoiled.desc: Bad smell, stale taste, mold, decomposed or fungus on food

insect.title: Insect or Foreign Object
insect.desc: Dead insect, cockroach, fly, worm, hair, glass, plastic, or stone in food

hygiene.title: Unhygienic Preparation
hygiene.desc: Dirty water, bare dirty hands, unwashed utensils, flies, rodents around food

expired.title: Expired Packaged Food
expired.desc: Expired 'Use By' / 'Best Before' date, torn seal, bloated packet

adulteration.title: Suspected Adulteration
adulteration.desc: Synthetic color, chemical smell, diluted milk, fake paneer, stone powder in spices

other.title: Other Food Safety Concern
other.desc: Any other food safety or hygiene issue not listed above

step2.title: Where did you buy or see the food?
step2.subtitle: Choose if this was a registered shop or a street stall

listed.title: Listed Shop / Restaurant
listed.desc: Registered grocery store, hotel, supermarket, or dairy found in our list

unlisted.title: Roadside Stall / Street Vendor / Unlisted Shop
unlisted.desc: Vadapav stall, tea stall, thela, cart, market seller, or shop not in our list

listedSection.searchPlaceholder: Search shop by name or city...

unlistedSection.notice: You can report any food stall even without an official registration. Street vendors are protected and welcome to be reported. Absence from our list does NOT mean the vendor is illegal.
unlistedSection.shopNamePlaceholder: e.g., Raju Chaat Centre (leave blank if unknown)
unlistedSection.landmarkPlaceholder: e.g., Opposite Railway Station Gate 2, near bus stand under big tree
unlistedSection.addressPlaceholder: e.g., Station Road, near auto stand
unlistedSection.fssaiPlaceholder: If displayed on banner or receipt (not required)

step3.title: Tell us more about the food
step3.subtitle: Share the food name and what happened
step3.productPlaceholder: e.g., Vadapav, Milk, Biryani, Samosa, Paneer
step3.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g., I bought vadapav this afternoon. The chutney had worms inside and the oil smelled burnt. Please inspect this stall.
step3.photoHelp: Clear photos of food, packaging, or stall help officers take faster action. Maximum size 5 MB (JPG, PNG, WEBP).

step4.title: Check your details before submitting
step4.subtitle: Review everything below. Tap 'Change' if you need to fix anything.
step4.confirmation: I confirm that this information is accurate to the best of my knowledge and submitted in good faith.
step4.disclaimer: FoodSafe AI is an independent citizen food safety reporting system. This filing will be reviewed by food safety teams.

success.title: Complaint Submitted Successfully!
success.subtitle: Thank you for helping keep food safe for everyone.
success.step1Text: Our food safety inspection team will review your report.
success.step2Text: If required, a field officer will be dispatched to inspect the seller.
success.step3Text: You can check progress anytime using your Complaint ID.
success.disclaimer: Note: FoodSafe AI Complaint ID is an independent grievance tracking reference. It is not an official government FSSAI registration number.

errors.categoryRequired: Please tap on a card to select what went wrong with the food.
errors.shopRequired: Please select a shop from the list.
errors.sellerTypeRequired: Please select what kind of food stall or seller it is.
errors.landmarkRequired: Please tell us where the food stall is located (landmark).
errors.productRequired: Please enter the name of the food item.
errors.descriptionRequired: Please write a few words explaining what happened (at least 5 characters).
errors.confirmationRequired: Please check the confirmation box before submitting.
errors.photoTooBig: Image file is too large. Please select a photo under 5 MB.
errors.photoBadFormat: Only JPG, PNG and WEBP image files are allowed.
errors.genericSubmitError: Could not submit your complaint. Please check your internet connection and try again.

voice.title: FoodSafe Voice — Speak Your Complaint
voice.subtitle: Speak in English, Hindi, or Marathi. We'll transcribe it for you to review, edit, and confirm.
voice.listening: Listening... Speak clearly into your microphone
voice.transcriptPlaceholder: Your spoken words will appear here...
voice.notSupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser. Please type your complaint in the box below.
voice.permissionDenied: Microphone permission was denied. Please allow microphone access in your browser settings or type below.
voice.noSpeech: No speech detected. Please tap the button and speak closer to your microphone.
voice.privacyNotice: Privacy: Voice is processed by your browser speech engine. No raw audio recordings are stored on our servers.

location.title: FoodSafe Location — Select Food Seller Location
location.subtitle: Choose how you'd like to identify where the food stall is located
location.permissionNotice: We request your location once to place the pin near you. You can then move the pin to the food stall's actual location.
location.locationFound: Location found! Move the marker if the stall is nearby, then tap Confirm.
location.mapHint: Tap on map or drag the green pin to the food seller's spot.
location.mapError: Could not load map tiles. You can still enter landmark manually.
location.privacyNotice: Privacy note: Coordinates are saved solely to locate the food seller. We never track your personal movements.

errors.notSupported: Geolocation is not supported by your browser.
errors.permissionDenied: Location permission was denied. Please enter the landmark manually below.
errors.timeout: Location request timed out. Please try again or enter landmark manually.
errors.unavailable: Location information unavailable. Please enter landmark manually.
errors.missingCoords: Both latitude and longitude must be selected.

intelligence.title: FoodSafe Intelligence
intelligence.subtitle: Complaint Analytics, Duplicate Detection & Hotspot Decision Support

hotspots.privacyNotice: Privacy Safeguard: Small clusters below threshold are suppressed. Coordinates are generalized and complainant identities are strictly redacted.

duplicates.noDuplicates: No pending duplicate complaint pairs identified.
duplicates.disclaimer: Records are never automatically merged or deleted. Both original complaints remain preserved.

risk.overrideSuccess: Priority successfully updated with documented rationale.
risk.disclaimer: Non-binding triage indicator. Does not constitute judicial or laboratory verification.

adulterationScreening.title: Food Adulteration Educational Screening
adulterationScreening.subtitle: Rule-based household rapid screening guidance adhering to official FSSAI DART guidelines.
adulterationScreening.disclaimer: FoodSafe AI provides educational screening guidance based on user-reported observations and basic food safety information. Results do not confirm food adulteration and are not a substitute for testing by an authorized laboratory or assessment by qualified food safety professionals.
adulterationScreening.scoreNote: Heuristic benchmark; not a calibrated probability or certified laboratory finding.
adulterationScreening.statutoryNotice: Statutory Notice: Household rapid tests screen for chemical or physical indicators under FSSAI DART manuals. Judicial enforcement requires accredited laboratory analysis.
